title: Cycle count on the Inactive tab counts only the inactive parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], tracked parts with part numbers starting ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC- : active [Part-A], inactive [Part-B] and [Part-C], each with quantity 5 (examples).

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL count A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL count B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-02 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL count C" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-03 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  5. Make [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-B] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  6. Make [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-C] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  7. Check the setup worked: the Inactive tab searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC lists [Part-B] and [Part-C]; the Active tab lists [Part-A].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC in the Search box.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar.
  5. Click Cycle count.
  6. Click the printer icon in the count toolbar and look at the printed count sheet (the print preview is enough).
  7. Close the print preview without printing.
  8. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
  9. Click the Active tab.
  10. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  11. Click Cycle count.
  12. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The menu on the Inactive tab offers Cycle count.
  • Step 5: The count starts on the Inactive tab: [Part-B] and [Part-C] are listed, each with an empty Count box; [Part-A] is not listed.
  • Step 6: The printed count sheet lists [Part-B] and [Part-C] and does not list [Part-A].
  • Step 8: The count ends without saving; quantities are unchanged.
  • Step 11: On the Active tab the count lists [Part-A] with a Count box, and does not list [Part-B] or [Part-C] (if the Search box was cleared, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC to see this).
  • Step 12: The count ends without saving.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S1-R10, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.7 (Cycle count leaves it out).
